post.summary: Draft quiz questions for a topic with the AI
post.description: Multiple-choice drafts from the topic's confirmed material (or, without any, the material closest to its name), each citing its source. They are stored as `pending`: students only see approved questions. Unusable drafts are dropped; `kind: no_source` when none is usable. Logged with its cost; not charged to any student.

patch.summary: Edit, approve or reject a question
patch.description: Any of the content fields and/or `status`. Changing the content of an AI draft marks it `edited`. Quizzes already started keep the version the student saw.

post.summary: Acknowledge the AI tutor disclosure for this course

get.summary: The tutor settings the teacher chose (read only)

post.summary: Ask the tutor; replies come only from validated material
Retry a message whose reply failed
Submit a worked exercise and get feedback on the mistake
post.description: The tutor checks the answer against the course material: verdict, first mistake, error type (`GET /v1/error-types`), course topic and a cited explanation. Mistakes with a type go to the learning record. Exercises the material does not cover are `not_assessed`. Counts toward the daily allowance, except when the tutor is unavailable (503). `is_stub` is always false and will be removed.

post.summary: A targeted review of a repeated mistake
post.description: Only for a submission with `repeated_mistake`, else 409 `no_repeated_mistake`. What is going wrong, a worked example and practice statements, grounded in the material. Created once (201) and counted toward the daily allowance; asking again returns the same review (200) for free.
Over the teacher's approved questions, for one topic or all. 409 `no_questions` when there are none. Answering never calls the model and does not count toward the daily allowance.

Immediate feedback: whether it was right, the correct option, the explanation and its sources, and the next question. `difficulty_change` says when and why the level moved. 409 `not_current_question` or `quiz_completed`.
